description: This file contains CMake script functions that implement JSON serialization and deserialization logic, defining callbacks for building JSON objects and arrays, handling JSON literals, and managing JSON callback functions.

methods.name: json
methods.description: Main function for processing JSON objects using callbacks, setting up context and handling nested JSON structure.

methods.name: json_obj_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning a JSON object, appending '{' to JSON string.

methods.name: json_obj_end
methods.description: Callback for ending a JSON object, appending '}' to JSON string.

methods.name: json_array_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning a JSON array, appending '['.

methods.name: json_array_end
methods.description: Callback for ending a JSON array, appending ']'.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning a key-value pair in a JSON object, converting key to JSON string and appending 'key:'.

methods.name: json_obj_keyvalue_end
methods.description: Callback for ending a key-value pair, appending ',' if there are more elements.

methods.name: json_array_element_end
methods.description: Callback for ending an array element, appending ',' if more elements follow.

methods.name: json_literal
methods.description: Handles JSON literals such as null, booleans, numbers, and strings, appending appropriate JSON representation.
